description: The discussions included plans for an AI University, Claude certification programmes and hosting government data within Karnataka.
body_lead: Karnataka is in talks with Anthropic to build a long-term partnership focused on deploying AI across governance, higher education, healthcare, scientific research and the state’s startup ecosystem, Chief Minister D K Shivakumar said after meeting the company’s leadership on August 6. The discussions covered the use of AI in public services, cybersecurity, data privacy, data sovereignty and skill development, with the government proposing that public-sector data be hosted within Karnataka.
